translations.customCards.name: Floorplan Heatmap
translations.customCards.description: Temperature distribution over a floor plan — with walls, doors, and windows as thermal resistance.
translations.card.emptyLine2: Edit card → open {button} and draw rooms.
translations.card.spreadTooltip: Spread between warmest and coldest sensor
translations.planEditor.title: Floor Plan & Sensors
translations.editor.autoRange: Automatically fit scale to sensor readings
translations.editor.viewAngleNote: These angles are just the starting point. In the card itself, you can rotate the model with the mouse at any time — that's purely a viewing choice and won't overwrite the default set here.
translations.editor.cellSizeNote: Smaller = finer and more accurate, but more compute-intensive. 6–10 px is a good compromise for apartments.
translations.editor.sensorRadiusNote: How large the area around a sensor point is that's held exactly at its value.
translations.editor.transmittanceNote: 0% = perfect insulation, 100% = like free air. These values determine how strongly heat is exchanged between adjacent areas.
translations.editor.dialogClosedWarning: floorplan-heatmap-card: The configuration dialog was closed while the floor plan editor was open. The changes could not be applied.
translations.tools.select.label: Select
translations.tools.select.hint: Click to select · drag to move · drag corner handles · type room dimensions on the right · Del removes
translations.tools.room.label: Room
translations.tools.room.hint: Drag for a rectangle · click repeatedly for a polygon (Enter or double-click closes it, Backspace undoes the last point)
translations.tools.wall.label: Wall
translations.tools.wall.hint: Click to set the start, click again for the end · type a length on the right and press Enter for an exact size
translations.tools.opening.label: Door / Window
translations.tools.opening.hint: Click on a wall — the opening snaps onto it and affects both adjoining rooms
translations.tools.sensor.label: Sensor
translations.tools.sensor.hint: Click to place a measurement point · assign the entity on the right
translations.tools.erase.label: Delete
translations.tools.erase.hint: Click an element to remove it
translations.tools.measure.label: Scale
translations.tools.measure.hint: Click a stretch of known length and enter its real length in meters
translations.planEditor.hintSuffix: Scroll wheel zooms, middle button or spacebar pans.
translations.planEditor.scaleNote: The scale only affects labels and the sensor radius — the temperature field itself is scale-free.
translations.planEditor.measureNote: Click a stretch whose real length you know — a room wall, for example. Then enter the length in meters.
translations.planEditor.name: Name
translations.planEditor.roomSizeNote: Dimensions are the outer edges — Enter or clicking elsewhere applies them. The top-left corner stays fixed; doors and windows don't move with it. Corner points can still be dragged at the white handles.
translations.planEditor.wallTypeNote: Room edges are automatically detected as exterior or interior walls; this type only applies to freestanding walls.
translations.planEditor.openingNote: Passage = open, door = clearly damped, window = almost sealed. The opening affects every wall at this spot — so both rooms, if two adjoin here.
